title: Why Korea Gets Monday Off for a Saturday Holiday

slides.headline: Korea is off today **for a Saturday holiday.**
slides.note: Saturday was National Foundation Day. So the whole country gets Monday instead.

slides.headline: It's called a **substitute holiday**
slides.body: When a national holiday lands on a weekend, the next weekday becomes a day off. Koreans call it daechegonghyuil (대체공휴일).

slides.headline: Until 2014, **a weekend holiday was just gone**
slides.body: If Chuseok fell on a Sunday, tough luck. The first substitute day off came in September 2014.

slides.headline: Then the list **kept growing**
slides.body: It started with Lunar New Year, Chuseok and Children's Day. National days joined in 2021, Buddha's Birthday and Christmas in 2023.

slides.headline: Substitute days **in 2026**
slides.body: March 2, May 25, Aug. 17 and today. Each one brought back a holiday that fell on a weekend.

slides.headline: Why Koreans **guard every day off**
slides.body: Korea works some of the longest hours in the OECD. A holiday lost to the weekend feels like a stolen one.

slides.headline: Not every worker **gets Monday**
slides.body: It's a paid day off at public offices and firms with five or more staff. At smaller shops, it's up to the boss.

slides.headline: This week has **two long weekends**
slides.body: Monday off now, Friday off for Hangul Day (한글날). Take three days of leave and you get nine days straight.

slides.headline: A weekend holiday **comes back on Monday**
slides.body: In Korea, a holiday that lands on a weekend isn't wasted anymore. It just moves.

slides.headline: Korea, explained **by a Korean.**
slides.body: Follow for the context behind the things Korea does.

caption:
Korea is off work today, a Monday, because a holiday fell on Saturday and the country gets it back as a substitute day.

Since 2014, Korean holidays that land on a weekend move to the next weekday, and the list keeps growing. This week Koreans get two long weekends in a row.

What happens in your country when a holiday falls on a weekend?
reply: Lunar New Year and Chuseok play by stricter rules: they only get a substitute day if they hit a Sunday or overlap another holiday. Land on a Saturday, and that day is simply lost. Children's Day has no such catch. What happens in your country when a holiday falls on a weekend, and do you get it back?
fact_check: 1장: 2026-10-03(토) 개천절 → 10-05(월) 대체공휴일. 국경일 대체공휴일은 토·일 모두 적용.
3장: 대체공휴일 첫 적용 2014-09-10(추석 연휴가 일요일과 겹침).
4장: 2021년 「공휴일에 관한 법률」로 국경일(3·1절·광복절·개천절·한글날) 확대(첫 적용 2021-08-16), 2023년 부처님오신날·성탄절 추가(첫 적용 2023-05-29).
5장: 2026년 대체공휴일 3/2(3·1절 일), 5/25(부처님오신날 5/24 일 — 음력 날짜 확인 필요), 8/17(광복절 토), 10/5(개천절 토). 설·추석은 2026년 대체 없음으로 판단, 확인 필요.
6장: 한국 연간 근로시간 OECD 상위권(2023년 약 1,870시간). 'some of the longest'로 완화.
7장: 2022-01-01부터 5인 이상 사업장 공휴일·대체공휴일 유급휴일 의무(근로기준법 55조). 5인 미만은 의무 아님.
댓글: 설·추석은 일요일 또는 다른 공휴일과 겹칠 때만 대체, 토요일은 미적용. 어린이날은 토·일 모두 적용.
